title: Field study record
description: One record per field study: real instruments, real operators, surveyed checkpoints held back from everything the product was built with. A verified record is an E5_EXTERNALLY_VALIDATED claim and nothing weaker may be filed here; E4 belongs in validation/cross-implementation and E6 in validation/reproduction. Validated by scripts/verify-field-study.mjs, which implements the JSON Schema subset used here without a runtime dependency and adds the cross-checks a schema cannot express, chief among them the checkpoint-leakage refusal that src/validation/checkpointAccuracy.ts applies to a checkpoint array and this verifier applies to a whole record. Filing a record does not move any claim's evidence level; promotion is a separate, human act recorded in docs/validation/claim-register.yaml. NOTHING IN THIS DIRECTORY IS A STUDY: it holds one EXAMPLE record and no field study has been run.

studyId.description: Stable identity. An example record must be prefixed EXAMPLE- and carry example: true, so a reader and the verifier agree about what is real.

claimId.description: Must exist in docs/validation/claim-register.yaml. The verifier reads that register and never writes it.

example.description: True only for a template. An example is excluded from every count whatever its status, and may not carry a result.

evidenceLevelClaimed.description: A field study is the E5 container. The single permitted value is here rather than implied so a record cannot quietly claim the reproduction level it did not earn.

protocolDigest.description: sha256 over the canonical protocol object (claim, instrument accuracy, survey method, checkpoint count and provenance, metrics) as registered BEFORE fieldwork. The verifier recomputes it, so a tolerance loosened after seeing the residuals no longer matches.

status.description: See FIELD_STATUSES in scripts/verify-field-study.mjs. blocked-external is separate from unavailable on purpose: a survey crew that does not exist is not a missing package.

result.description: Present only when checkpoints were actually observed and reduced. A status of pending or not-executed carrying a result is rejected.

preregistration.description: The protocol as frozen before anyone went to the site. A protocol written afterwards is a report, not a preregistration, and the verifier compares the dates.

protocolPath.description: Repo-relative path to the frozen protocol document. The verifier hashes the file on disk.

witness.description: What makes the registration date checkable by someone else: the commit that first filed the protocol, a timestamping service receipt, or a registry entry. The digest alone proves nothing, because whoever rewrites the record can recompute it.

crs.description: The frame every coordinate in the record is in. A metric claim without a frame is not checkable.

strata.description: Land-cover or terrain classes the checkpoints are stratified by. A pooled RMSE over open ground and dense canopy describes neither.

instrument.description: The reference instrument, and what its manufacturer or its calibration certificate says it can do. A study cannot resolve an error smaller than the survey that measured it.

source.description: Where the figure comes from: a datasheet, a calibration certificate, or a field check. Not the operator's recollection.

checkpoints.description: The surveyed positions the product is compared against. Provenance and usage are the two fields that decide whether the study is worth reading: a checkpoint that fed registration, control, parameter tuning or manual correction is part of the surface being tested, and an accuracy figure over it measures the fit rather than the error.

usages.description: How the checkpoints were used, one entry per usage, with counts that must add up to `count`. The permitted values are CHECKPOINT_USAGES from src/validation/checkpointAccuracy.ts; anything else cannot be shown to be independent and is refused rather than assumed independent.

independentOfProcessing.description: An explicit statement that no checkpoint entered registration, control, parameter tuning or manual correction of the surface under test. Stating it is not proof; the verifier also checks the usage counts, and refuses when the two disagree.

rawPath.description: Repo-relative path to the observation file. Required once a result exists: an accuracy figure whose sample nobody can reconstruct is the thing this container refuses to hold.

operators.description: Who ran the instrument. One operator is a measurement; independent operators are what turns operator technique from an unmeasured confound into an observed one.

independent.description: True only when at least two operators worked without sharing a setup, a procedure walkthrough or each other's results, and none of them is affiliated with this project.

candidate.description: The OpenLiDARViewer side: the exact revision whose output was compared against the survey.

product.description: What was tested: the DTM, a volume, a distance. The surface the checkpoints must not have leaked into.

metrics.description: The acceptance gate, registered before fieldwork and covered by protocolDigest.

uncertaintyCombinationId.description: The preregistered rule that folded the survey's own uncertainty into the reported figure, echoed from src/validation/checkpointAccuracy.ts. Null when none was applied, never a relabelled observed RMSE.

scope.description: What the study supports, and what it explicitly does not. notCovered may never be empty: a field study that states no boundary is being read as covering everything.
